The container starts on a fresh Docker host without a chown by hand, and PUID and PGID pick the account it runs as.

## ✨ Added

- **PUID and PGID.** Started without `--user`, the container is root only long enough to give the empty folders Docker has just created for it to PUID:PGID, 1000:1000 unless you set them, and then runs as that account. A folder that already holds something keeps its owner. With `--user`, as in the Unraid template, nothing changes and PUID and PGID are not read. Settings, Health & diagnostics shows whether they were applied.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The `docker run` from the README works on a fresh host.** Docker creates a missing bind-mount folder as root, so KnightLoader could not write its own data folder and restarted in a loop until you ran `chown` on the host. This happened on MOS and on any Docker host that does not create the folders itself the way Unraid does.
- **Hints that name an account name the right one.** A program that cannot be run, an action the system refuses and a folder KnightLoader may not write into name the uid and gid it actually runs as, instead of always 1000.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new and changed text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
